provenance.pixelCoordinates: Approximate original-image screen pixels: x rightward, y downward. They are inventory locations, not physical quantities.

inventory.description: One tall upright thick rectangular outline, approximately x=14..258, y=51..418. Interior sides are near x=22 and x=250, floor near y=409. The lower left outside corner is irregular. This is one apparatus and one panel, not a before/after pair.
relationships: Packed flattened outlines lie below the piston and above the floor.

inventory.description: One thick vertical central rod, approximately x=126..148, y=13..321, attached to one dark horizontal piston approximately x=17..253, y=315..349. Rod protrudes above the top. The white space above the piston is tall; the dense liquid layer below it is shallow.
relationships: Piston is near the floor but leaves a visible liquid layer.
The rod splits the upper white region into left and right visible areas, not separate panels.

inventory.description: Many white narrow, horizontally elongated ovals/lens-like shapes with thick dark boundaries fill approximately x=22..250, y=347..409. They form irregular staggered height bands, approximately eight to nine apparent layers, not an exact grid. Some are open, merged, clipped by the top piston or floor, or indistinguishable from interstitial gaps. The original depicts flattened molecular outlines as its compression convention.
inventory.countStatus: UNRESOLVED: neither exact individual molecule count nor exact discrete row-column dimensions can be read reliably from the merged and clipped glyphs.

pixelComponentAid.method: Original grayscale threshold: white >180; four-neighbor connected components; no closure for the retained primary observation.
pixelComponentAid.interpretation: This includes molecule interiors, compound regions and interstices. It is explicitly NOT a particle count.
pixelComponentAid.interpretationOfSensitivity: Counts and assignments change with gap closure; a region count cannot establish source molecule conservation.

inventory.description: No readable labels, numerical values, scale, axis, ticks, grid, bond network, motion arrows, external force arrow, or between-panel transition arrow. A tiny stray dark mark at the upper left outside the container and tiny lower-left outside specks have no identifiable instructional meaning.
inventory.artifactMapping: If a future candidate omits the outside stray specks, explicitly classify the omission as scan/printing artifact removal, not removal of a particle or source relationship.

modernQualificationMapping.approvedTextConstraint: The source uses molecular deformation, but the more careful explanation is sharply increasing short-range repulsion as molecular spacing decreases.
modernQualificationMapping.justifiedAddition: If the flattened outlines are retained, an explicit English label must identify them as the source's schematic convention rather than a literal sole mechanism.
modernQualificationMapping.notAuthorized: Silently replace every flattened source outline with a smaller round molecule and claim the source drawing has been preserved.

modernQualificationMapping.sourceFact: A densely packed layer under a piston.
modernQualificationMapping.approvedTextConstraint: Further compression usually requires a large force; liquids have low but nonzero compressibility.
modernQualificationMapping.justifiedAddition: A separately identified qualitative English repulsion explanation could be added. Any new applied-force arrow or explanatory panel is a modern addition, since no force arrow or second panel occurs in the original.
modernQualificationMapping.notAuthorized: Numerical forces, elastic constants, compression ratios, a zero-compressibility claim, or a literal molecular-flattening explanation without the approved qualification.

decision.reason: Exact source-count preservation is required. Open, compound and wall-clipped flattened glyphs prevent a justified one-to-one count; guessing an ellipse population or tracing compound pixels as individual molecules would evade that requirement.
